Problem Statement:
write a program to check the given two number is an amicable number or not 
Input Description:
The input contains an integer 
Output Description:
If its Amicable print Yes otherwise No 
Explanation:
Amicable numbers are two different numbers so related that the sum of the proper divisors of each is equal to the other number. 
Sample Input:
220 284 
Sample Output:
Yes
